answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 27544 Country: India Title: I have a problem of irregular periods. Sometimes i dnt have period even for six months. I beleive dat in islam there is solution to every problem. Is there any dua or amal which i may do in order to regularize my periods. I will be eagerly waiting for ur reply. Question: assalamoalaikum wa rehmatullahi wa barakaatahu, i have a problem of irregular periods. Sometimes i dnt have period even for six months. I beleive dat in islam there is solution to every problem. Is there any dua or amal which i may do in order to regularize my periods. I will be eagerly waiting for ur reply. JazakAllah hu khairan. Wassalamoalaik Answer ID: 27544 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1825/L=517/tl=1431) You should recite Surah al-Fatiha seven times daily early morning, blow it on water and drink it. In-sha-Allah, it shall remove the problem of your irregular periods. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
